text_block_list.text:
The time has come! I'm going to show
everyone at
the pool how super fun I
really am!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Um, Scarlet, how come you're wearing
your
school swimsuit? I thought we were
just gonna
hang out?!
text_block_list.name: Friend A

text_block_list.text:
This is no time for fun and games!
Today's the real
test!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: I don't get it, but I'll join you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Eager to showcase her polished
reactions, Daiwa
Scarlet starts playing in
earnest.
Eeeek! Oh my gosh! Staaahp! ♪ The water's, like, literally freezing! ♪
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Yikes! That water slide is, like, soooo up
there!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff. Well, Spe? Did all those reactions seem fun and natural?
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Not sure what's going on here, but yeah,
totally!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hey, anyone else want to order
anything? One
sec... I'd like one
whipped vanilla frappe, please!
text_block_list.name: Friend B

text_block_list.text:
Food, huh? All right, I'll take a large
curry and a
large ramen...
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: You're that hungry?
text_block_list.name: Friend A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, apparently. All this fun is hard
work, you
know.
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. She's really taking this stuff
seriously, isn't
she?
text_block_list.name: Friend A

text_block_list.text:
You think? I feel like she takes
everything super
seriously, though.
text_block_list.name: Friend B

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Scarlet, look! They're having a
swimsuit
dance competition!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
A dance competition... That sounds like
the
perfect opportunity to show how fun
I am!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Let's do it! Time to show off our moves,
Spe!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Look at her! She's in her school
swimsuit!
text_block_list.name: Male Spectator

text_block_list.text:
Why's she scowling like that?! She's
hysterical!
text_block_list.name: Female Spectator

text_block_list.text: (Yes! Yes! They're seeing how fun I am!)
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
(But I can't let up! I have to focus on
dancing until
the very end!)
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: And so the day comes to an end.

Great job! Looks like we all had a ton of
fun!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: So, everyone, was I funny today?
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: You were hilarious! Just like always!
text_block_list.name: Friend B

text_block_list.text:
Huh? You mean nothing seemed
different today?
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Nope. You're always so serious about
everything.
I don't think I'll ever get
tired of it.
text_block_list.name: Friend B

text_block_list.text:
But you were especially hilarious today!
Let's
hang out again sometime soon! ♪
text_block_list.name: Friend A

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, from before. Fancy seeing
you here.
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет
choice_data_list:
On your way home? Were you hanging out with
friends?

text_block_list.text:
Yes. And I tried really hard to be less of
a
stick-in-the-mud...
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
But I guess I'm not actually as boring as I
thought
I was.
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Still, I think my efforts paid off today.
I'm just
going to keep tackling things
head-on as they
come my way.
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Thanks a lot for listening! See you later!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you were, like, weirdly
overenthusiastic.
Which made it even
funnier, I guess?
text_block_list.name: Friend B

text_block_list.text: Was she always that animated, though?
text_block_list.name: Friend A

text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! Scarlet's always been on the
wild side!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You should have seen that dual-wield
slipper
technique she used against
Водка that one time!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, Spe! You've said enough!
Stop!
Please!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Her shouts of protest echo through the
air. It
seems like all her hard work has
made her a
source of surreal comedy.

She continues her journey home with a
spring in
her step and a smile on her
face—the face of
someone who's
anything but boring.
